commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Ready Obeka on OUR turn and exile already-stacked, one-shot next-end-step lose/exile/sacrifice liabilities; convert temporary creatures and risky extra turns to lasting card/turn advantage.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 — Optimized; compact paid combos exist, but commander 1UBR/haste/turn-window dependence and interaction risk prevent an honest Bracket 5 cEDH claim.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Protect risky RR turns, commander-timed clone/reanimation, haste and tap support. Reject generic Thassa Oracle/Consult and The Master Multiplied replacing the commander's task.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: The exact October 20 source-bound M6 table audits all 99 distinct noncommander physical slots. Rechallenged 12: six selected weak cuts plus preserved Psychic Vortex, Rionya, Counterspell, Venser, Fellwar Stone and Discontinuity. Kept fast mana/talismans, protection, all risky RR turns, Scepter, Twinflame/Dualcaster, Courser and permanent-copy engines.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: 34 unchanged lands, ten artifact mana pieces plus Jeska's Will; one basic each of Island/Mountain/Swamp and fetchable duals supply 1UBR. Selected six MV total 19 replacing MV total 25; reduce heavy red pips, add two single-black role spells. Retains all U/B/R dual access and Talisman/Signet ramp; no speculative cut of an untapped colored source.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Retains Counterspell, Mana Drain, Fierce Guardianship, Force of Will, Deflecting Swat, Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Toxic Deluge; backup Sundial and Discontinuity, Greaves/Boots/Elixir/Arena/Minamo. Cannot force opponent to end their own turn or use summoning-sick Obeka; removal in the end-step window remains serious.

weakest_slots.weakness: Four-mana attack/d20 source whose token exile is a normal recurring end-of-combat ability, not a one-shot liability.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Delina can immediately multiply ETBs and enabled a Kiki line, but it does not permanently save its own tokens with a single Obeka use.

weakest_slots.weakness: Three-mana symmetric wheel can refill opposing interaction, and Obeka has stronger unusually focused setup demands.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retaining it would help generic hand refill and discard, but Entomb directly supplies Footsteps, Apprentice, Animate Dead, Necromancy and Feldon.

weakest_slots.weakness: Five-mana red/artifact-restricted creature-cheat redundancy with Sneak Attack and many existing haste sources.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Purphoros supplies durable global haste; Mimic Vat needs actual nontoken death plus three-mana activation but creates reusable one-shot clones.

weakest_slots.weakness: Five-mana attack-gated hand cheat needs a combat turn, a creature in hand and commander timing.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Ilharg can permanently cheat a body after Obeka catches the return; Conscripts impacts ETB immediately and forms a deterministic Kiki loop.

weakest_slots.weakness: Four-mana one-shot copies depend entirely on opposing creatures being available and worth copying.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Hate Mirage can make two strong opposing tokens at once; Splinter Twin is slower to set up but makes repeatable own ETBs and pairs with Conscripts.

weakest_slots.weakness: Four-mana repeated extra draw requires Obeka to suppress a newly recurring full-hand discard every turn.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Dragon is high lift and worthwhile in slower hands; Spellseeker is a cheaper, cloneable ETB which finds Final Fortune, Twinflame or Entomb.

weakest_slots.weakness: Four-mana UU engine has a fresh land-sacrifice/hand-discard trigger every own end step and needs an available end-turn effect.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retain: its cumulative upkeep draws more cards each turn rather than costing more mana; BBB Dawn is narrower, later and grave-dependent.

weakest_slots.weakness: Five-mana combat copier may produce only one clone on low-spell turns and is vulnerable before a combat step.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retain: recurring combat-token engine does not require top graveyard card ordering or five mana for buyback; Corpse Dance adds redundancy.

weakest_slots.weakness: Double-blue universal interaction competes with assembling low-cost two-card Scepter/Final Fortune engines.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retain: Muddle can transmute for the key MV2 pieces, but losing an answer to creatures/artifacts/enchantments exposes Obeka's full-turn liabilities.

weakest_slots.weakness: Six-mana flash modal commander-native value demands a costly turn before Obeka can transform its temporary copy.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retain: Cauldron Dance is combat-only, costs 4BR and needs both a hand body and a graveyard body to exceed Venser's flexible spell interaction.

weakest_slots.weakness: Two-mana opponent-dependent colored mana source is rarely spectacular in triple-pip turns.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retain: Tribute Mage can tutor Scepter, but exchanging turn-two color development for turn-three tutoring weakens early 1UBR Obeka access.

weakest_slots.weakness: Four-mana own-turn backup can be clunky beside Sundial and Obeka.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retain: it exiles the entire stack and independently ends the turn; one-mana Stifle removes one trigger but cannot replace the emergency turn-ending role.

whole_deck_audit.current_baseline_strength: October 15 approved source already had nineteen deliberate commander-native upgrades: 100 unique cards, 34 lands, strong risky-turn redundancy, ability haste and protection. M6 Pass C identified two serious research-only swaps but did not authorize them.
whole_deck_audit.candidate_pool_scope: Revisited 181 historical M5 pairwise hypotheses (not 181 reliable win tests), M6 99-card roles, Josh-Lee-Kwai Stage C, live EDHREC inclusion/high lift and optimized tags, seventeen material candidates plus high-cost alternatives and two complete higher-count 100s.
whole_deck_audit.off_ranked_search_conclusion: Spellseeker/Entomb precise tutor density, Mimic Vat delayed-token ETBs, Splinter Twin plus Zealous clone finish stand above extra generic draw or reanimation; Dawn BBB, Corpse Dance graveyard order, Muddle counter restriction and other off-ranking options lose deckwide value.

candidate_sources: Existing M6 whole-100 deep review and formal owner-equivalent Pass C sealed Stage C; 181 exploratory M5 pairwise screens are not effect-aware competitive win-rate claims.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Selected complete six-slot engine/combo package; 100 cards, 34 lands and 100 current Commander-legal Grixis identities.
Complete seven-slot source-verified portfolio; improved MV2 transmute access at the cost of no longer stopping arbitrary permanent spells.
Complete eight-slot more recursive package; loses both all-spell counter and repeatable Rionya combat clones; gravity of graveyard hate and top-card order grows.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Footsteps over Delina (rather than Avaricious Dragon) corrects the Delina recurring Oracle problem while keeping extra draw until the stronger Spellseeker ETB is chosen; Mimic Vat instead cuts slow red-restricted Purphoros and preserves Rionya and Psychic Vortex. Delina cannot stay to create durable tokens merely because the first exile stack ability is removed.

It leaves genuine resilience and engine ceiling on the table.

Additional seventh/eighth swaps hurt protection or native token repetition.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After selecting six changes, separately retested pressure on retained Counterspell, Rionya, Psychic Vortex, Venser, Fellwar Stone and Discontinuity. Each saves an irreplaceable answer, native repeatable copy or colored-source/access function. Every higher-count plausible add carries a specific real loss, not a numerical quota concern.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Transmute finds Scepter/Final Fortune but losing the unconditional UU answer to enemy creatures/artifacts/enchantments is a worse all-pod risk.
Corpse Dance costs five with buyback and returns only the ordered top grave creature; Rionya repeatedly creates multiple one-shot tokens with no graveyard dependency.
Vortex's cumulative upkeep is DRAW cards and Obeka suppresses the recurring land/hand end-step cost; Dawn costs BBB and only reanimates when graveyard stocked.
Cauldron Dance needs 4BR and combat-window plus creatures in hand and grave; Venser's flashed interaction/copied permanent provides a superior varied ceiling.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Seven-slot exact 100 gives Muddle transmute for both key MV2 Scepter/Fortune cards and defensive instant/sorcery counter.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Counterspell handles non-instant permanent spells and is a necessary unqualified shield before high-risk extra turns.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Eight-slot exact 100 increases tutor and hasty graveyard reanimation with reusable buyback in a single package.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Lose unconditional counter and repeatable native clone engine, pay expensive buyback and face increased graveyard hate, so the extra quantity is not extra quality.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stopped after examining 17 material additions, twelve incumbents, actual six/seven/eight-slot whole-100 alternatives and source-bound rules. The extra seventh Muddle loses indispensable whole-spell interaction, and eighth Corpse Dance replaces repeatable on-theme Rionya with conditional graveyard-order buyback. Other candidates add BBB, extra combat gates, randomness or commander bypass; no remaining credibly quality-positive change justified an additional slot.
